Rule Explanation:
Evaluates DbtDt across prioritized conditions:
1. Security Erosion: Sets DbtDt to @PROCESSDATE when security erosion triggers a shift to Doubtful (DB1).
2. NPA Aging Progression: Sets DbtDt to SysNPA_Dt + SUB_Months upon transitioning from Sub-Standard to Doubtful.
3. Default Fallback: Retains existing DbtDt.
